output.summary: A genus of perennial stem succulents native to eastern and southern Africa and Arabia. Its five-lobed, often vividly striped flowers can be funnel- or bell-shaped and commonly emit a carrion-like scent that attracts flies. In southern Ethiopia, various Huernia species are boiled and eaten with sorghum as famine food.
